name: Album of Daoist and Buddhist Themes: Procession of Daoist Deities: Leaf 14
summary: These six martial figures are Field Marshals in the Daoist pantheon. In the lower row from left to right are Field Marshals Li Feng 李封, Tie Tou 鐵頭, Gao Tong 高銅, and Wang Tie 王鐵.
